description: Amending existing front porch with pitch roof
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( Drawings of proposed scheme 100(P4),101(P4), 102(P4), 300(P4), 301(P4), 303(P4), Fire Safety Plan, Fire Safety Statement - All received on  20/03/2023; Drawings of existing conditions 100(P3), 101(P3), 102 (P3), 300(P3), 301(P3), 302(P3), 303 (P3); Design and Access statement, Location and Proposed block plan 010 (P4)- Received on 21/03/2023 ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
